content:
OWNER APPROVAL — CONTINUE AND FINISH AUTONOMOUS DEPLOYMENT NOW

You are explicitly authorized to continue.

Do not stop at another checkpoint.

Proceed now with the already completed local implementation.

1. Review the local changes once for security and correctness.

2. Add any missing token revocation and replay-protection checks required for production.

3. Create and apply the database migration for:
   ivx_worker_access_tokens

4. Run all tests again.

Required:
- worker-access token tests
- internal deploy authorization tests
- owner authentication tests
- TypeScript validation
- database migration validation
- replay rejection test
- expired-token rejection test
- action mismatch test
- commit SHA mismatch test

5. Commit the changes to:
   ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest

6. Push to:
   main

7. Return the new GitHub commit SHA.

8. Deploy the exact new commit to the existing Render services:
   - ivx-holdings-platform
   - ivx-senior-dev-01

9. Do not create a new repository.
10. Do not create a new Render service.
11. Do not deploy an old commit.
12. Do not ask for IVX_OWNER_TOKEN_SESSION again.

13. After deployment, use the new owner-authenticated endpoint:

   POST /api/ivx/senior-developer/generate-worker-access

14. Use the authenticated owner session from the IVX application or owner web dashboard.

15. Generate one short-lived, single-use worker authorization for:
   - exact action
   - exact deployed commit SHA
   - approved worker ID
   - 5–15 minute expiration

16. Do not store the raw token.
17. Store only the SHA-256 token hash.
18. Pass the raw token securely to the worker one time.
19. Consume it atomically.
20. Reject replay.

21. Run one live QA-only autonomous job.

The job must verify:
- /health returns HTTP 200
- /version returns the deployed SHA
- GitHub HEAD matches Render live SHA
- public chat returns HTTP 200
- owner endpoint without auth returns HTTP 401
- unauthorized mutation returns HTTP 401 or 403
- proof ledger records the execution

22. Verify the worker completes the job.

23. Verify the authorization is marked used.

24. Attempt a second use of the same token and prove replay is rejected.

25. Return final live evidence:

IMPLEMENTATION
- Files changed
- Migration filename
- Test results
- TypeScript result

GITHUB
- Repository
- Branch
- Commit SHA
- Push status

RENDER API
- Service ID
- Deployment ID
- Live SHA
- Status
- Boot time

RENDER WORKER
- Service ID
- Deployment ID
- Live SHA
- Worker heartbeat
- Last completed job

OWNER AUTHORIZATION
- Authorization ID
- Owner verification: PASS / FAIL
- Approved action
- Approved commit SHA
- Expiration
- Stored as hash only: YES / NO
- Consumed: YES / NO
- Replay rejected: YES / NO

AUTONOMOUS JOB
- Job ID
- Worker ID
- Initial status
- Final status
- Proof ledger ID
- Completion timestamp

LIVE PRODUCTION
- /health status
- /health response
- /version status
- /version SHA
- Public chat status
- Owner unauthenticated test
- Unauthorized mutation test

FINAL STATUS
- Autonomous deployment: PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

Do not stop after commit.
Do not stop after push.
Do not stop after deployment.
Do not return another plan.

Complete the full chain:
CODE → TEST → COMMIT → PUSH → DEPLOY → AUTHORIZE → EXECUTE → VERIFY → PROVE.
